editorial:
Imagine living in total fear because people you love are dropping dead around you for no clear reason. That is exactly what happens to Clara. She is stuck in a nightmare where her boyfriend and friends are being picked off one by one. The vibe is super tense because she is convinced that a famous writer she worked for a decade ago is finally getting his revenge. You will feel her panic as she realizes she is part of a deadly game that will not stop until the seventh person is gone. It feels like a race against time where nobody can be trusted.

What really works here is how the tension builds up slowly until it hits a breaking point. The acting is solid and makes you feel the weight of the mystery. While some parts of the plot move a bit slow, the big twists make it worth the wait. If you love stories about secrets coming back to haunt people, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the writer was not the one killing everyone. Clara was actually the one causing the deaths due to a split personality and deep guilt from her past. She had been blacking out and killing the people around her to fit the pattern of the writer's old stories. In the end, she realizes she is the seventh victim of her own mind, bringing the circle of death to a close.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and dark secrets.
